rows.goal: Master transformer architectures and attention for research
limitations: No coverage of transformer architecture or attention mechanisms.
Content is too elementary for an advanced learner; lacks mathematical depth.
Missing discussion of training tricks, optimization, or advanced loss functions.
No mention of modern deep learning frameworks or best practices beyond basic SGD.

rows.goal: Learn deep learning from beginner to intermediate
limitations: No discussion of regularization techniques (dropout, weight decay).
No coverage of convolutional or recurrent architectures, which are essential for many applications.
Minimal mathematical detail; backpropagation is only described conceptually.
No mention of advanced optimizers (Adam, RMSProp) or learning rate schedules.
Limited coverage of hyperparameter tuning beyond learning rate and epochs.
No exploration of model evaluation metrics beyond loss curves.
No discussion of data preprocessing or feature engineering.
